subject: Engineering decisions
title: Console flow keyboard frame
question: What did the recorded experiment show?
method: Original decision-log entry and measurements are preserved verbatim below.
finding: console flow keyboard frame (n=1 per configuration, no model). The full LeetCode flow suite ran in 27.64 s on the baseline and 28.35 s with the console tap helper settling the web keyboard's scheduled frame inside React act. Both ran 697 passing tests and 13 skips. The initial run had three failures from keyboard-store updates outside act. Keep the frame boundary for console flows.
